“成交。”晏梨爽快地说道。

至少目前看来，她和陈沅的目的是一致的，都是要从那透明魔方格子里救人。

就算陈沅包藏祸心，他不是海德没有经过特训，远远不是她的对手。

陈沅眼中带了喜色，他不再犹豫，直接吐露出了自己查到的秘密，因为过于激动，身边的墨鱼不停的吐着黑泡泡。

“海星号根

“那要怎么办？”萧翎也有点着急，自己要去做卧底的事情要是被警方的内鬼直接给透入过去了，那还有什么意义。

这感觉，真的是非常非常的宁静，相安无事这么的下去，那也是蛮好的。

完成之后，她照镜子左右看了看，自觉还算满意，对着镜子中的人勾唇笑了下。

总设计师此时也被感染，和旁边的维修人员说了，让他们继续在这里修控制器，他和韩警官直奔轨道。

曹操愣神了，他知道孙坚是有强大战斗力的，刘备手下两个兄弟也是很厉害，但是他们要怎么才能够成为自己最大的对手？

"Deal." Yan Li said cheerfully.

At least for now, it seems that she and Chen Yuan have the same purpose, to save people from the transparent Rubik's Cube.

Even if Chen Yuan harbors evil intentions, he is not Hyde and has not undergone special training, so he is far from her opponent.

Chen Yuan's eyes were filled with joy. He no longer hesitated and directly revealed the secret he had found. Because he was so excited, the cuttlefish beside him kept spitting black bubbles.

"Starfish Roots"

"What to do?"Xiao Ling was also a little anxious. If his undercover work was directly penetrated by the police mole, what would be the point.

This feeling is really, really peaceful. It would be nice to live in peace and quiet.

After finishing, she looked around in the mirror and felt that she was quite satisfied. She smiled at the person in the mirror.

The chief designer was also infected at this time and told the maintenance staff nearby to continue repairing the controller here. He and Officer Han went straight to the track.

Cao Cao was stunned. He knew that Sun Jian had strong fighting power, and Liu Bei's two brothers were also very powerful, but how could they become his biggest opponents?
